_comment: THE LEGACY BASIS, kept for forensics and reproduction -- not for new work. Production is
encoder/esk_balanced/spacetime (the base config); this overlay is the basis that preceded
it, encoder/esk/spacetime, built 2026-08-19 18:12 with random landmarks and no windowed
augmentation.
WHAT IT IDENTIFIES. Two artifacts on disk were made with this basis and are therefore NOT
production, despite sitting at the production paths:
encoder/desk/env_model_semisup.pth   2026-08-20 08:28
encoder/cube/                        2026-08-20 10:38 (built from that checkpoint)
Both predate encoder/esk_balanced/spacetime (2026-08-21 12:01) and must be rebuilt before
anything downstream consumes them: spacetime-esk is already done, so `desk` then `cube`.
HOW THE MISMATCH WAS FOUND, since the numbers are the clearest statement of why it matters.
The 2026-09-04 validate run graded that Aug-20 checkpoint through the BALANCED basis. Its
own internal control gives the size of the effect -- `no_change` is computed entirely
inside the grading basis and came out at 0.46745043992996216 in all four reports, while
DESK's median error moved:
desk (Aug-20 ckpt, graded in esk_balanced)   0.8046   wins 5.8% of rows
desk_tempho_1975 (Aug-21 ckpt, same basis)   0.4340   wins 58.1%
desk_tempho_1985 (Aug-21 ckpt, same basis)   0.4432   wins 56.4%
desk_tempho_1995 (Aug-21 ckpt, same basis)   0.4507   wins 55.5%
The null does not move because it never leaves the grading basis; DESK's error nearly
doubles because its coordinates are in the other one. The two bases agree as kernels (Gram
relative difference 0.016) and differ by a rotation (Procrustes residual 0.089, median
||z_A - z_B|| = 1.087x ||z||), which is precisely why every contract check passed while the
comparison was meaningless.
Reproducing an Aug-20-era artifact:
ESK_DESK_CONFIG=config/overlays/basis_esk_native.json STAGES=<stage> bash scripts/tacc/submit_encoder.sh
Note landmark_mode/augment_windowed/balance are carried too: they define the basis and the
training target, so the paths alone would not reproduce anything.
